("supplier_payments"."description" is null or char_length("supplier_payments"."description") <= 140)
        and ("supplier_payments"."cancel_reason" is null or char_length("supplier_payments"."cancel_reason") <= 500)

supplier_payments_lifecycle_check.name: supplier_payments_lifecycle_check
supplier_payments_lifecycle_check.value:
(("supplier_payments"."cancelled_at" is null) = ("supplier_payments"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null))
        and (("supplier_payments"."cancelled_at" is null) = ("supplier_payments"."cancel_reason" is null))
        and (("supplier_payments"."instruction_exported_at" is null) = ("supplier_payments"."instruction_exported_by_user_id" is null))
        and (("supplier_payments"."instruction_exported_at" is null) = ("supplier_payments"."instruction_export_count" = 0))

supply_requests_text_check.name: supply_requests_text_check
supply_requests_text_check.value:
char_length("supply_requests"."justification") between 5 and 1000
        and ("supply_requests"."decision_note" is null or char_length("supply_requests"."decision_note") <= 500)
        and ("supply_requests"."fulfillment_note" is null or char_length("supply_requests"."fulfillment_note") <= 500)
        and ("supply_requests"."cancel_reason" is null or char_length("supply_requests"."cancel_reason") <= 500)

supply_requests_lifecycle_check.name: supply_requests_lifecycle_check
supply_requests_lifecycle_check.value:
("supply_requests"."status" = 'submitted' and "supply_requests"."decided_at" is null and "supply_requests"."fulfilled_at" is null and "supply_requests"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("supply_requests"."status" = 'approved' and "supply_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "supply_requests"."decided_by_user_id" is not null and "supply_requests"."fulfilled_at" is null and "supply_requests"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("supply_requests"."status" = 'rejected' and "supply_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "supply_requests"."decided_by_user_id" is not null and "supply_requests"."decision_note" is not null and "supply_requests"."fulfilled_at" is null and "supply_requests"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("supply_requests"."status" = 'fulfilled' and "supply_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "supply_requests"."fulfilled_at" is not null and "supply_requests"."fulfilled_by_user_id" is not null and "supply_requests"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("supply_requests"."status" = 'cancelled' and "supply_requests"."decided_at" is null and "supply_requests"."fulfilled_at" is null and "supply_requests"."cancelled_at" is not null and "supply_requests"."cancelled_by_user_id" is not null and "supply_requests"."cancel_reason" is not null)

teacher_mentorship_meetings_text_check.name: teacher_mentorship_meetings_text_check
teacher_mentorship_meetings_text_check.value:
char_length("teacher_mentorship_meetings"."topic") between 2 and 200
        and ("teacher_mentorship_meetings"."note" is null or char_length("teacher_mentorship_meetings"."note") between 1 and 4000)
        and ("teacher_mentorship_meetings"."next_step" is null
          or char_length("teacher_mentorship_meetings"."next_step") between 1 and 500)

teacher_mentorships_closed_check.name: teacher_mentorships_closed_check
teacher_mentorships_closed_check.value:
(("teacher_mentorships"."status" = 'active') = ("teacher_mentorships"."closed_on" is null))
        and (("teacher_mentorships"."closed_on" is null) = ("teacher_mentorships"."closed_by_user_id" is null))
        and (("teacher_mentorships"."status" = 'ended_early') = ("teacher_mentorships"."end_reason" is not null))
        and ("teacher_mentorships"."end_reason" is null
          or char_length("teacher_mentorships"."end_reason") between 5 and 500)

trip_plan_events_status_check.name: trip_plan_events_status_check
trip_plan_events_status_check.value:
"trip_plan_events"."to_status" in ('draft', 'submitted', 'approved', 'rejected', 'completed', 'cancelled')
        and ("trip_plan_events"."from_status" is null or "trip_plan_events"."from_status" in ('draft', 'submitted', 'approved', 'rejected', 'completed', 'cancelled'))
        and (("trip_plan_events"."event" = 'created') = ("trip_plan_events"."from_status" is null))

trip_plan_events_note_check.name: trip_plan_events_note_check
trip_plan_events_note_check.value: "trip_plan_events"."note" is null or char_length("trip_plan_events"."note") between 1 and 500

trip_plans_paid_activity_key.name: trip_plans_paid_activity_key
trip_plans_paid_activity_key.where: "trip_plans"."paid_activity_id" is not null and "trip_plans"."archived_at" is null and "trip_plans"."status" <> 'cancelled'

trip_plans_text_check.name: trip_plans_text_check
trip_plans_text_check.value:
char_length("trip_plans"."name") between 3 and 120
        and char_length("trip_plans"."purpose") between 10 and 2000
        and ("trip_plans"."transport_company" is null or char_length("trip_plans"."transport_company") between 2 and 120)
        and ("trip_plans"."transport_plate" is null or "trip_plans"."transport_plate" ~ '^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{1,3}[0-9]{2,5}$')
        and ("trip_plans"."driver_name" is null or char_length("trip_plans"."driver_name") between 2 and 120)
        and ("trip_plans"."driver_phone" is null or "trip_plans"."driver_phone" ~ '^0[0-9]{10}$')
        and ("trip_plans"."authority_reference" is null or char_length("trip_plans"."authority_reference") between 1 and 60)

trip_plans_terms_check.name: trip_plans_terms_check
trip_plans_terms_check.value:
"trip_plans"."return_at" > "trip_plans"."departure_at"
        and "trip_plans"."expected_student_count" between 1 and 2000
        and jsonb_typeof("trip_plans"."stops") = 'array'
        and jsonb_array_length("trip_plans"."stops") between 1 and 30
        and jsonb_typeof("trip_plans"."risks") = 'array'
        and jsonb_array_length("trip_plans"."risks") <= 30
        and jsonb_typeof("trip_plans"."emergency_contacts") = 'array'
        and jsonb_array_length("trip_plans"."emergency_contacts") <= 5

trip_plans_status_fields_check.name: trip_plans_status_fields_check
trip_plans_status_fields_check.value:
("trip_plans"."status" not in ('approved', 'completed') or "trip_plans"."approved_at" is not null)
        and ("trip_plans"."approved_at" is null or "trip_plans"."status" in ('approved', 'completed', 'cancelled'))
        and (("trip_plans"."approved_at" is null) = ("trip_plans"."approved_by_user_id" is null))
        and ("trip_plans"."status" <> 'rejected' or "trip_plans"."rejected_at" is not null)
        and ("trip_plans"."rejected_at" is null or "trip_plans"."status" in ('rejected', 'cancelled'))
        and (("trip_plans"."rejected_at" is null) = ("trip_plans"."rejection_reason" is null))
        and ("trip_plans"."rejection_reason" is null
          or char_length("trip_plans"."rejection_reason") between 5 and 500)
        and ("trip_plans"."status" = 'draft' or "trip_plans"."status" = 'cancelled' or "trip_plans"."submitted_at" is not null)
        and ("trip_plans"."authority_notified_on" is null or "trip_plans"."approved_at" is not null)
        and ("trip_plans"."authority_reference" is null or "trip_plans"."authority_notified_on" is not null)
        and (("trip_plans"."status" = 'completed') = ("trip_plans"."completed_at" is not null))
        and (("trip_plans"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("trip_plans"."cancelled_at" is not null))
        and (("trip_plans"."cancelled_at" is null) = ("trip_plans"."cancel_reason" is null))
        and ("trip_plans"."cancel_reason" is null
          or char_length("trip_plans"."cancel_reason") between 5 and 500)

teacher_work_permits_approval_check.name: teacher_work_permits_approval_check
teacher_work_permits_approval_check.value:
(("teacher_work_permits"."status" = 'approved') = ("teacher_work_permits"."approval_date" is not null))
        and (("teacher_work_permits"."status" = 'approved') = ("teacher_work_permits"."approval_number" is not null))
        and ("teacher_work_permits"."status" = 'approved' or "teacher_work_permits"."valid_until" is null)
        and ("teacher_work_permits"."approval_number" is null
          or char_length("teacher_work_permits"."approval_number") between 1 and 60)

teacher_work_permits_dates_check.name: teacher_work_permits_dates_check
teacher_work_permits_dates_check.value:
("teacher_work_permits"."approval_date" is null or "teacher_work_permits"."approval_date" >= "teacher_work_permits"."application_date")
        and ("teacher_work_permits"."valid_until" is null or "teacher_work_permits"."valid_until" >= "teacher_work_permits"."approval_date")
        and ("teacher_work_permits"."rejection_date" is null or "teacher_work_permits"."rejection_date" >= "teacher_work_permits"."application_date")

teacher_work_permits_rejection_check.name: teacher_work_permits_rejection_check
teacher_work_permits_rejection_check.value:
(("teacher_work_permits"."status" = 'rejected') = ("teacher_work_permits"."rejection_date" is not null))
        and (("teacher_work_permits"."status" = 'rejected') = ("teacher_work_permits"."rejection_reason" is not null))
        and ("teacher_work_permits"."rejection_reason" is null or char_length("teacher_work_permits"."rejection_reason")
          between 5 and 500)

teacher_work_permits_cancel_check.name: teacher_work_permits_cancel_check
teacher_work_permits_cancel_check.value:
(("teacher_work_permits"."archived_at" is null) = ("teacher_work_permits"."cancel_reason" is null))
        and (("teacher_work_permits"."archived_at" is null) = ("teacher_work_permits"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null))
        and ("teacher_work_permits"."cancel_reason" is null or char_length("teacher_work_permits"."cancel_reason")
          between 5 and 500)

invoices_installment_key.name: invoices_installment_key
invoices_installment_key.where: "invoices"."archived_at" is null and "invoices"."root_contract_id" is not null

language_group_waitlist_student_key.name: language_group_waitlist_student_key
language_group_waitlist_student_key.where: "language_group_waitlist"."archived_at" is null and "language_group_waitlist"."student_id" is not null and "language_group_waitlist"."status" in ('waiting', 'offered')

language_group_waitlist_prospect_key.name: language_group_waitlist_prospect_key
language_group_waitlist_prospect_key.where: "language_group_waitlist"."archived_at" is null and "language_group_waitlist"."prospect_id" is not null and "language_group_waitlist"."status" in ('waiting', 'offered')

language_group_waitlist_offer_check.name: language_group_waitlist_offer_check
language_group_waitlist_offer_check.value:
(("language_group_waitlist"."offer_group_id" is null) = ("language_group_waitlist"."offered_at" is null)
          and ("language_group_waitlist"."offered_at" is null) = ("language_group_waitlist"."offer_expires_at" is null))
        and ("language_group_waitlist"."status" <> 'waiting' or "language_group_waitlist"."offered_at" is null)
        and ("language_group_waitlist"."status" not in ('offered', 'accepted', 'expired') or "language_group_waitlist"."offered_at" is not null)
        and ("language_group_waitlist"."offer_expires_at" is null or "language_group_waitlist"."offer_expires_at" > "language_group_waitlist"."offered_at")

language_groups_room_check.name: language_groups_room_check
language_groups_room_check.value:
("language_groups"."room" is null) = ("language_groups"."room_key" is null)
        and ("language_groups"."room" is null or char_length("language_groups"."room") between 1 and 60)
        and ("language_groups"."delivery" = 'in_person' or "language_groups"."room" is null)

language_groups_lifecycle_check.name: language_groups_lifecycle_check
language_groups_lifecycle_check.value:
("language_groups"."state" = 'planned' and "language_groups"."opened_at" is null and "language_groups"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("language_groups"."state" = 'open' and "language_groups"."opened_at" is not null and "language_groups"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("language_groups"."state" = 'cancelled' and "language_groups"."cancelled_at" is not null
          and "language_groups"."cancel_reason" is not null)

language_groups_cancel_check.name: language_groups_cancel_check
language_groups_cancel_check.value:
("language_groups"."cancel_reason" is null or char_length("language_groups"."cancel_reason") between 1 and 500)
        and ("language_groups"."merged_into_group_id" is null
          or ("language_groups"."state" = 'cancelled' and "language_groups"."merged_into_group_id" <> "language_groups"."id"))

payments_reference_key.name: payments_reference_key
payments_reference_key.where: "payments"."reference" is not null and "payments"."reversed_at" is null

payments_reversal_check.name: payments_reversal_check
payments_reversal_check.value: ("payments"."reversed_at" is null and "payments"."reversed_by_user_id" is null and "payments"."reversal_reason" is null) or ("payments"."reversed_at" is not null and "payments"."reversed_by_user_id" is not null and "payments"."reversal_reason" is not null)

consents_withdrawal_check.name: consents_withdrawal_check
consents_withdrawal_check.value:
("consents"."withdrawn_at" is null) = ("consents"."withdrawn_by_user_id" is null)
        and ("consents"."withdrawn_at" is null) = ("consents"."withdrawal_reason" is null)

consents_dates_check.name: consents_dates_check
consents_dates_check.value:
("consents"."expires_at" is null or "consents"."expires_at" > "consents"."given_at")
        and ("consents"."withdrawn_at" is null or "consents"."withdrawn_at" >= "consents"."given_at")

privacy_notices_topic_check.name: privacy_notices_topic_check
privacy_notices_topic_check.value:
("privacy_notices"."kind" = 'notice' and "privacy_notices"."audience" is not null and "privacy_notices"."purpose" is null and not "privacy_notices"."requires_reconsent")
        or ("privacy_notices"."kind" = 'consent_text' and "privacy_notices"."purpose" is not null and "privacy_notices"."audience" is null)

prospect_documents_rejection_check.name: prospect_documents_rejection_check
prospect_documents_rejection_check.value: ("prospect_documents"."status" <> 'rejected' or "prospect_documents"."rejection_reason" is not null) and ("prospect_documents"."rejection_reason" is null or "prospect_documents"."status" in ('rejected', 'superseded'))

prospect_documents_link_check.name: prospect_documents_link_check
prospect_documents_link_check.value: ("prospect_documents"."student_id" is null) = ("prospect_documents"."linked_at" is null) and ("prospect_documents"."student_id" is null) = ("prospect_documents"."linked_by_user_id" is null)

rubric_versions_published_check.name: rubric_versions_published_check
rubric_versions_published_check.value:
("rubric_versions"."status" = 'draft') = ("rubric_versions"."published_at" is null)
        and ("rubric_versions"."status" <> 'published' or "rubric_versions"."archived_at" is null)
        and ("rubric_versions"."status" <> 'archived' or "rubric_versions"."archived_at" is not null)

score_appeals_decision_check.name: score_appeals_decision_check
score_appeals_decision_check.value:
("score_appeals"."outcome" is null) = ("score_appeals"."decided_at" is null)
        and ("score_appeals"."outcome" is null) = ("score_appeals"."decided_by_user_id" is null)
        and ("score_appeals"."outcome" is null) = ("score_appeals"."decision_reason" is null)
        and ("score_appeals"."decided_at" is null or "score_appeals"."decided_at" >= "score_appeals"."filed_at")

submission_versions_draft_revision_check.name: submission_versions_draft_revision_check
submission_versions_draft_revision_check.value: "submission_versions"."draft_revision" is null or ("submission_versions"."draft_revision" >= 1 and "submission_versions"."body" is not null)

task_assignments_attempts_check.name: task_assignments_attempts_check
task_assignments_attempts_check.value:
("task_assignments"."kind" = 'practice') = ("task_assignments"."max_attempts" is null)
        and ("task_assignments"."max_attempts" is null) = ("task_assignments"."count_policy" is null)
        and ("task_assignments"."max_attempts" is null or "task_assignments"."max_attempts" between 1 and 3)
        and ("task_assignments"."count_policy" is null or "task_assignments"."count_policy" in ('first', 'highest'))
        and ("task_assignments"."count_policy" is distinct from 'highest' or "task_assignments"."max_attempts" > 1)
        and ("task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'auto' or "task_assignments"."max_attempts" is null
          or ("task_assignments"."max_attempts" = 1 and "task_assignments"."count_policy" = 'first'))

task_assignments_deadline_check.name: task_assignments_deadline_check
task_assignments_deadline_check.value:
("task_assignments"."kind" = 'practice' or "task_assignments"."due_at" is not null)
        and "task_assignments"."late_acceptance_days" between 0 and 7

task_assignments_second_rating_check.name: task_assignments_second_rating_check
task_assignments_second_rating_check.value:
"task_assignments"."second_rating_percent" between 0 and 100
        and ("task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'teacher' or "task_assignments"."second_rating_percent" = 0)
        and not ("task_assignments"."kind" = 'practice' and "task_assignments"."high_stakes")
        and (not "task_assignments"."high_stakes" or "task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'auto' or "task_assignments"."second_rating_percent" >= 10)

task_assignments_mode_check.name: task_assignments_mode_check
task_assignments_mode_check.value:
("task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'teacher') = ("task_assignments"."submission_settings" is not null)
        and ("task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'teacher' or "task_assignments"."rubric_version_id" is null)
        and ("task_assignments"."scoring_mode" = 'auto'
          or ("task_assignments"."time_limit_minutes" is null and "task_assignments"."listening_plays" is null))

student_guardians_student_parent_key.name: student_guardians_student_parent_key
student_guardians_student_parent_key.where: "student_guardians"."parent_id" is not null and "student_guardians"."archived_at" is null

student_guardians_student_membership_key.name: student_guardians_student_membership_key
student_guardians_student_membership_key.where: "student_guardians"."membership_id" is not null and "student_guardians"."archived_at" is null

student_guardians_identity_check.name: student_guardians_identity_check
student_guardians_identity_check.value: "student_guardians"."parent_id" is not null or "student_guardians"."membership_id" is not null

student_guardians_restriction_check.name: student_guardians_restriction_check
student_guardians_restriction_check.value: not "student_guardians"."is_contact_restricted" or ("student_guardians"."custody" = 'none' and not "student_guardians"."is_payer" and not "student_guardians"."is_pickup_authorized")

student_withdrawals_refund_bank_account_.name: student_withdrawals_refund_bank_account_check
student_withdrawals_refund_bank_account_.value: "student_withdrawals"."refund_bank_account_id" is null or "student_withdrawals"."refund_paid_date" is not null
